heading: INT. RARE BOOKS READING ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. RARE BOOKS READING ROOM - NIGHT
Oak tables.
Green-shaded lamps.
Fire doors sealed against the cold.
Behind a glass wall, shelves of locked cases rise into shadow.
CATALINA ROJAS, 40s, head librarian, sits at the desk with a cotton glove on each hand.
She is turning the pages of a ledger and does not look up.
She is calm, orderly, someone whose life has been alphabetical.
Across the room, VIKRAM SHARMA, 30s, a visiting scholar in a corduroy jacket, hunches over a folio with a magnifying glass.
A laptop sits open beside him.
He has been reading the same page for an hour.
By the door, ELLSWORTH DUVAL, 50s, security, in a navy blazer, leans on the wall and checks his phone.
He yawns.
She glances at the clock.
Closing in ten minutes.
She stands, collects a tray, and walks the aisle to Vikram's table.
He covers the folio with his arm before she reaches it.
She stops.
She smiles.
He smiles back, too quickly.
We close at ten, Dr. Sharma.
units.name: CATALINA

units.text: Of course. Just finishing.
units.name: VIKRAM

units.text: Is it a good page?
units.name: CATALINA

units.text: It's a page.
units.name: VIKRAM

units.text: She sets the tray down beside him.
She does not take the folio.
Instead she turns to Ellsworth and nods, a small, precise tilt of the head.
He puts away his phone and straightens.
Vikram sees it.
His hand moves under the table.
That's a first edition. Seventeen-twelve. We've had it since the war.
units.name: CATALINA

units.text: It's magnificent.
units.name: VIKRAM

units.text: Plate nine is missing.
units.name: CATALINA

units.text: Vikram doesn't answer.
He lifts his arm.
The folio opens to a clean stub where a plate has been razored out.
It was missing when I got it.
units.name: VIKRAM

units.text: It was in the case at four.
units.name: CATALINA

units.text: Ellsworth crosses the floor in six long steps.
Vikram stands.
His chair crashes backward.
His hand comes out from under the table with a short folding knife.
Ellsworth halts.
Nobody breathes.
Catalina does not move.
The lamp hums.
She speaks gently, as if to a child.
Put it on the table, Dr. Sharma.
units.name: CATALINA

units.text: For a long beat he stares at her.
Then his arm drops.
The knife clatters onto the oak.
Ellsworth takes his wrist and turns him.
Vikram does not resist.
Catalina takes the folio.
She smooths the stub with a gloved fingertip.
Where is it?
units.name: CATALINA

units.text: In my laptop sleeve.
units.name: VIKRAM

units.text: She nods.
Ellsworth fishes the plate out and hands it to her.
She lays it flat between two sheets of tissue.
The tension drains from the room.
Ellsworth sighs.
Vikram slumps.
Catalina closes the folio and turns off the lamp.
